name: calendar-delete-event
description: Delete a calendar event. An occurrence's id deletes only it; its masterEventId deletes the series. By default, attendees receive cancellation emails. Set notifyAttendees=false to suppress those emails on Google. Microsoft rejects false and the delete fails; iCloud ignores it and still emails.

inputs.notifyAttendees: boolean? (omit to notify. false suppresses cancellation emails on Google only; Microsoft rejects false, iCloud ignores it.)
inputs.mailbox: string? (mailbox id; required for an unregistered calendar or "primary" when several are connected)
